Cost planning

A practical way to plan your AI budget

Understand billing units before estimating monthly spend.

RunBridge AI · Field notes 2 min read

Start with workload volume

Estimate successful user tasks per month and the average number of model calls per task. Allow for user iteration and failed requests according to your actual billing rules.

Separate the units

For text, track input and output tokens separately. For image and video, identify whether the endpoint bills by tokens, output count, duration or another unit.

Make assumptions explicit

Keep the chosen model, rate, output settings and expected volume together. Use ranges when your workload is not yet measured. The pricing-page estimator is a starting point, not a quote.

Compare estimates with usage

Once your account is live, compare estimates against actual usage records. Review outliers and expensive flows before setting product limits or customer pricing.
